resolution.note: fast selects test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts for an added or renamed test/rules file; test red before the fix, green after

title: npm run fast skips the CI rule coverage check for a new test/rules file
body:
Source: PR #1221 (t-y9gvftp), 2026-11-16: npm run fast PASSED with '0 tests' after adding test/rules/json-schema-subset.test.ts; CI then failed test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts ('every check CI runs maps to one enforced, scoped, dated record': + node --test test/rules/json-schema-subset.test.ts), one wasted CI round.
Outcome: when a change adds or renames a file under test/rules/, npm run fast also runs test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts; a test asserts the selection.
Proof: node --test test/scripts/fast-check.test.ts: pass (selection for an added test/rules file contains test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts)
Files: scripts/fast-check.ts
